name: Hybrid
description: A VM on OpenStack that reads a bucket on AWS, in one deployment.

fields.startup_script:
#!/bin/sh # Clutter puts the bucket's name and region, and a key that can only read it, in CLUTTER_FILES_*. mkdir -p /etc/app echo "FILES_BUCKET=$CLUTTER_FILES_BUCKET" > /etc/app/files.env echo "FILES_REGION=$CLUTTER_FILES_REGION" >> /etc/app/files.env # Serve a page on port 80 with what the image has: python3 (Amazon Linux, # Ubuntu), else busybox httpd, else a busybox nc loop (cirros). dir=/var/www/clutter mkdir -p "$dir" page() { printf '%s

%s

%s

\n' "$1" "$1" "$2" > "$dir/index.html"; } page app "Served by its startup script on port 80." cd "$dir" if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then # A service, so the page comes back after a restart (a resize restarts the server). printf '[Unit]\nDescription=Clutter example web page\nAfter=network.target\n[Service]\nWorkingDirectory=%s\nExecStart=%s -m http.server 80\nRestart=always\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\n' "$dir" "$(command -v python3)" > /etc/systemd/system/clutter-web.service systemctl daemon-reload systemctl enable --now clutter-web.service else nohup python3 -m http.server 80 >/var/log/clutter-web.log 2>&1 & fi elif busybox --list 2>/dev/null | grep -qx httpd; then busybox httpd -p 80 -h "$dir" else while true; do { printf 'HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n'; cat "$dir/index.html"; } | nc -l -p 80 >/dev/null 2>&1; done & fi
